messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Halcyon account shows a 38% drop in DAU over the last 14 days. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Advocate (their CTO) left last Thursday and they've onboarded a new data lead. Could be churn risk. :warning:
jamal_csm: ugh. do we know if the new data lead has product context? any signal they met with AE?
tyler_ae: i pinged Halcyon last week, we were scheduled for a follow-up but they rescheduled. they mentioned a vendor POC (LumenAI) in the workstream.
olivia_sales: noted — LumenAI popped in our competitive tracker last month (custom embedding pipeline + lower price). i can try to get a read from the rep.
maria_cs: quick snapshot of usage (last 30 days):
```
- active seats: 42 -> 26 (down 38%)
- API calls/day: 12.4k -> 7.6k
- avg tokens/session: 320 -> 200
```
ops-bot: Reminder: account has renewal_contract_due=2026-05-14 and enterprise_support=true.
jamal_csm: likely root causes: lost advocate + new data lead evaluating alternatives + usage regression on batch jobs. recommend immediate re-onboard session + short audit of dropped flows.
tyler_ae: agree. propose: (1) 30-min sync with new data lead this week, (2) run quick health-check report highlighting failing routes, (3) offer a 2-week free concierge for migration w/ dedicated SE.
maria_cs: action items: @tyler_ae schedule sync w/ new data lead (target Thu), @olivia_sales confirm if LumenAI POC started and scope, @jamal_csm prepare health-check artifacts (logs, failing route ids, top-5 error types). i'll draft a short re-engage note to send after we confirm call.
olivia_sales: i can ask rep for details and whether they're proposing model replacement or just adjunct service. ETA EOD. :mag_right:
tyler_ae: booked tentative 30-min on Thu 10am PT (provisional). sending calendar invite now — will include agenda: quick product tour, migration pain points, pricing concerns.
jamal_csm: uploading checklist in thread: bring the following to call — (a) sample dropped requests, (b) perf trend graphs, (c) ROI snapshot for current plan vs proposed alternatives.
maria_cs: if they surface pricing as primary friction, we have two levers: temporary seat credit or limited-rate discount + commit. prefer to push for operational fixes first.
ops-bot: NOTE: recent deploy changed batching defaults on prod for halcyon-org; deploy id 2026-04-02-824. if that correlates to drop window, flag to eng-runtime.
tyler_ae: that deploy lines up with the usage dip. tagging @eng-runtime in follow-up.
olivia_sales: update: LumenAI rep says pilot started but only exploratory — they haven't ingested full dataset. sounds like opportunity to win back if we move quick.
maria_cs: ok — priority: triage deploy impact + 30-min sync with new data lead + competitive intel from Oliva. who wants to own follow-up note + internal playbook for a 'save' motion?
jamal_csm: i'll own the internal playbook and health-check. will have first draft by tomorrow noon.
tyler_ae: i'll take the follow-up note and present options on the call.
maria_cs: perfect. i'll keep this thread for updates. if we confirm deploy regression, i'll open urgent incident with eng-runtime for a rollback or patch. :white_check_mark:
